notes: One prompt, one build, 14 minutes. The dashboard is a real app: 20 seeded bookings, working search, status filter, detail view, editable status that survives a reload, and a CSV export. What it does not do: show an error on a wrong password, and the row body is not clickable. Publishing needed an explicit publish click. Lovable also flagged an unresolved security finding in its own scan; not investigated.

pricing.free_plan: Free plan with daily credits, publishes to a lovable.app subdomain; paid plans from EUR 25/month (Pro), checked on the German pricing page
